name: Local notes API
brief: Build a local-only Python notes API with persistent SQLite storage and comprehensive tests. Do not deploy or use paid services.

tasks.title: Implement and test the notes API
tasks.spec: Create a FastAPI app with GET /notes and POST /notes, validate nonempty note bodies, persist notes in SQLite, add pyproject.toml and tests. Test real create/list behavior, validation, and persistence across application instances. Add README installation and operating instructions. All pytest tests must pass with at least one collected test.

tasks.title: Complete delivery documentation and release checks
tasks.spec: Verify the API and tests from the preceding task, add CHANGELOG.md and SECURITY.md describing local-only use, backup and restore, test commands and deployment requirements. Add a tests/test_delivery.py that asserts README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and SECURITY.md exist and contain meaningful content. Do not deploy.
